title: VECTOR DRIFT
oneLiner: Original inertial wraparound space shooter with rotating thrust-driven ships, three rock split sizes, bounded projectiles, warned saucers, hyperspace and cooperative sector clears.
mechanics: Rotate the ship, thrust and retain momentum; brake to stabilize aim.
Ships, rocks and projectiles wrap across matching screen edges with matching wrapped collision.
Large rocks split into two medium rocks; each medium splits into two small rocks.
Saucers announce entry before firing aimed shots.
Hyperspace chooses a safer position and gives brief protection with a six-second cooldown.
Clear all rocks to advance sectors; each player has independent controls and lives.
lose: The team runs out of lives after rock or projectile collisions.
scoring: 20 for large rocks, 50 for medium, 100 for small, 250 for a saucer and 500 per cleared sector.
